text:
nina: Quick heads-up 14dd
TideBridge private/VPC onboarding: dry-run tomorrow 08:30 PT. Need a pre-check on peering routes, NAT capacity, CMK grants, and CloudTrail delivery. @rahul can you scope network? @sophie can you validate KMS + audit role?

rahul: on it. I'll verify VPC peering attachments between tidebridge-prod and analytics-shared, and confirm route table entries. Prioritizing: prod-app, prod-worker, redis-private.

sophie: KMS checklist OK. I'll ensure the CMK has redwood-audit role and cloudtrail principal. Also will confirm key rotation enabled and capture creation date for compliance.

rahul: found one missing peer-route in prod-worker-rtb -> added route to pcx-0c1d2e3f. Command used: `aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0f1e2d3c --destination-cidr-block 10.40.0.0/16 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0c1d2e3f` change id chg-0b1c2d3e.

ops-bot: infra-bot: Route create event recorded (chg-0b1c2d3e) by rahul at 2026-03-23T02:12:05Z

rahul: NATs: account has 1 NAT gateway in us-west-2 (nat-0123abcd). Prod-app subnets use it; redis-private was mistakenly using IGW route (public) 1 flagged and patched to NAT.

nina: good catch. Please add nat utilization note to runbook (burst capacity needed if they enable heavy telemetry).

sophie: CMK arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:555566667777:key/aa11bb22 created 2024-10-15. Policy lacked CloudTrail service principal. Sample allow to add: `{"Sid":"AllowCloudTrail","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}`. I'll push a policy PR.

rahul: security groups: found sg-0a9b8c7 allowing wide egress 0.0.0.0/0 TCP ephemeral from prod-worker. I'll tighten to internal subnets and list in gist.

nina: please paste the SG export link when ready so CS can attach to ticket.

rahul: uploaded: https://gist.github.com/redwood/tidebridge-sg-routes (includes SGs, NACLs, nat list, route snapshots)

ops-bot: compliance-bot: KMS policy PR #3679 opened by sophie (adds CloudTrail principal + audit role).

sophie: also noted procurement request: HSM-backed KMS option and 7-year audit retention. I'll add a migration note to use alias `alias/tidebridge-audit-kms` and a one-time S3 re-encrypt job.

nina: renewal risk: mark as "medium" for now due to HSM ask; solutions to provide cost delta. I'll add to customer health card and include mitigation steps in SOW draft.

rahul: final quicktests queued after patches. Will run smoke tests and post results here by 03:30 PT.

sophie: perms sweep done in staging; CloudTrail principal added and rotation ON. Will share policy JSON in runbook.

nina: thanks all 44d I'll update the onboarding runbook and send to TideBridge ops for acknowledgement. Closing this thread.
